title: Flood in Nepal - EMSR927 baseline dossier

event.location_summary: Rasuwa District and downstream Trishuli River corridor, Nepal.

sources.license_note: CEMS data are publicly accessible; the fixture retains a cited curated summary for the baseline only.
USGS event information is preliminary or provisional and subject to revision.

sources.publisher: International Charter: Space and Major Disasters
sources.license_note: The Charter activation is cited for event context and uncertainty, not used as an operational command source.

claims.statement: CEMS activation EMSR927 identifies a flash flood in Nepal affecting Rasuwa District and the downstream corridor.
The retrieved CEMS summary reports 5,300 affected people, 3,207 identified affected buildings, 46 affected road kilometres, and 26 affected bridge or elevated-highway features across completed AOIs.
USGS describes a likely glacial-collapse trigger and marks its findings preliminary, while the International Charter says the precise cause of the sudden surge remains under investigation.
Bharatpur was pending delivery in the retrieved CEMS activation response and must remain an explicit data gap.

impact_summary.note: These are source-reported impact estimates from the frozen baseline dossier, not independently verified casualty figures.

data_gaps: Bharatpur AOI was pending delivery at the fixture retrieval time.
This fixture does not include a raw upstream CEMS response or geospatial product archive.
The initiating mechanism remains preliminary and must not be stated as certain.
safety_note: The fixture is decision-support input only. It cannot authorize public warnings, evacuation orders, dispatches, or infrastructure control.
